corpusNotes: Every native 2400x1080 frame retained on this host on 2026-09-27 from the FNaF 1-4 device runs (~/fnaf-apks/fnaf{1,3,4}-device-runs, ~/fnaf-apks/explore/f4-*, captures/fnaf-title-observe-*, captures/fnaf1-title-observe-*, captures/fnaf3-control-surface-*, captures/fnaf3-gate-validation-*) and the FNaF 2 campaign frames named in artifacts/campaign-*/observations.jsonl. Frames stay on the host; only their sha256 prefixes are here.

The game is the run directory's game, except three frames read by eye whose directory named another game: fnaf3-gate-validation 00-pre and 03-after-back show the FNaF 2 title, fnaf3-control-surface t1 shows the FNaF 3 title.

Labels: FNaF 4 frames were labelled by eye from contact sheets (title, transition, options, warning = the sound-cue warning screen, other, unlabelled = explore/f4-views and f4-n1 room frames). FNaF 1 and FNaF 3 labels come from file names (title when the name says title). FNaF 2 labels come from the campaign observation rows (title when the row read state=title or items=), which the FNaF 2 title observer wrote -- so FNaF 2 title recall is partly circular.

The identity rule and the FNaF 4 model thresholds were chosen on this corpus; there is no held-out block. The device check that follows the Companion 0.2.0 install is the first frame set they did not see.
rowFormat: {model: [title, foreign, menu]} for models whose title box read above 0; absent where every model refused
rule: a game only when exactly one registered title model claims the frame (title gate present, foreign gate absent) and no other model competes (a second claim, or a logo box read present but held back by its foreign gate or a static bar)
